import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
rows[35]['owner_crop']['gt2_whole_neighbour_words']='yes'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r in rows:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(cards)==len(rows)
assert [x['card_id'] for x in cards]==[x['card_id'] for x in rows]
assert len({x['card_id'] for x in rows})==len(rows)
fields={'card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'}
for r in rows:
 assert fields<=r.keys()
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u']
 assert r['marks'] in ['y','n','na']
 assert r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert len(r['owner_crop'])==5 and all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
print('Count and order verified:',len(rows))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(r[k] for r in rows)))
print('Errors:',collections.Counter(e for r in rows for e in r['errors']).most_common())
